rules.statement: A co-owner's signature on an amicable partition plan is not sufficient to terminate co-ownership in relation to divided portions depicted in the plan.
rules.supporting_quote: Such placement of signature can only be construed as co-owner’s expression of consent and willingness to transfer or renounce their rights in relation to the lots allocated to the other co-owners but such plan itself cannot be construed as an instrument or writing renouncing or transferring such co-owned rights.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Fraud ordinance
